mapper.select: SELECT c.USER_ID as userId, c.SALE_ITEM_ID as saleItemId, SUM(c.QUANTITY) as quantity, TO_CHAR(MAX(c.CREATED_TIME), 'YY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS.FF9') as createdTime, TO_CHAR(MAX(c.UPDATED_TIME), 'YY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS.FF9') as updatedTime, s.TITLE as productTitle, s.TITLE as title, s.DESCRIPTION as productDescription, s.DESCRIPTION as description, s.PRICE as price, s.QTY as stock, s.QTY as availableQty, s.JUDGE_KIND_NAME as productType, s.JUDGE_KIND_NAME as category, s.CUT_NAME as cutType, s.GRADE as grade, (SUM(c.QUANTITY) * s.PRICE) as totalPrice, c.SALE_ITEM_ID as cartItemId, pi.IMAGE_URL as productImageUrl FROM CART c INNER JOIN SALES s ON c.SALE_ITEM_ID = s.SALE_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMAGES pi ON s.SALE_ITEM_ID = pi.PRODUCT_ID AND pi.IS_THUMBNAIL = 'y' WHERE c.USER_ID = #{buyerId} GROUP BY c.USER_ID, c.SALE_ITEM_ID, s.TITLE, s.DESCRIPTION, s.PRICE, s.QTY, s.JUDGE_KIND_NAME, s.CUT_NAME, s.GRADE, pi.IMAGE_URL ORDER BY c.SALE_ITEM_ID

SELECT c.USER_ID as userId, c.SALE_ITEM_ID as saleItemId, c.QUANTITY as quantity, TO_CHAR(c.CREATED_TIME, 'YY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS.FF9') as createdTime, TO_CHAR(c.UPDATED_TIME, 'YY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS.FF9') as updatedTime, s.TITLE as productTitle, s.TITLE as title, s.DESCRIPTION as productDescription, s.DESCRIPTION as description, s.PRICE as price, s.QTY as stock, s.QTY as availableQty, s.JUDGE_KIND_NAME as productType, s.JUDGE_KIND_NAME as category, s.CUT_NAME as cutType, s.GRADE as grade, (c.QUANTITY * s.PRICE) as totalPrice, c.SALE_ITEM_ID as cartItemId, pi.IMAGE_URL as productImageUrl FROM CART c INNER JOIN SALES s ON c.SALE_ITEM_ID = s.SALE_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMAGES pi ON s.SALE_ITEM_ID = pi.PRODUCT_ID AND pi.IS_THUMBNAIL = 'y' WHERE c.USER_ID = #{userId} AND c.SALE_ITEM_ID = #{saleItemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CART (USER_ID, SALE_ITEM_ID, QUANTITY, CREATED_TIME, UPDATED_TIME) VALUES (#{userId}, #{saleItemId}, #{quantity}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CART WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND SALE_ITEM_ID = #{saleItemId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.USER_ID as userId, c.SALE_ITEM_ID as saleItemId, c.QUANTITY as quantity FROM CART c WHERE c.USER_ID = #{userId} AND c.SALE_ITEM_ID = #{saleItemId}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO CART c USING (SELECT #{userId} as USER_ID, #{saleItemId} as SALE_ITEM_ID, #{quantity} as QUANTITY FROM DUAL) s ON (c.USER_ID = s.USER_ID AND c.SALE_ITEM_ID = s.SALE_ITEM_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET c.QUANTITY = c.QUANTITY + s.QUANTITY, c.UPDATED_TIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_ID, SALE_ITEM_ID, QUANTITY, CREATED_TIME, UPDATED_TIME) VALUES (s.USER_ID, s.SALE_ITEM_ID, s.QUANTITY, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(c.QUANTITY * s.PRICE), 0) FROM CART c INNER JOIN SALES s ON c.SALE_ITEM_ID = s.SALE_ITEM_ID WHERE c.USER_ID = #{buyerId}
